messages.subject: I think I got something wrong with nonstationary kappa and tau parametrization
parts:
Hello, 
I an trying to work with a model with nonstationary Matérn range (the kappa). 
I started from Advanced Spatial Modeling with Stochastic Partial Differential Equations Using R and INLA, but I had some difficulties to retrieve estimates of the "true" range parameter values. So I decided to go for a stationary synthetic data set. I did a run using INLA and got a satisfying interpolation of the observed Gaussian Process, however I think that there is something off with my estimates of kappa. Could you please tell me if something seems wrong ?
Thank you a lot, as usual
Sébastien
